lines.t: Well, I heard that call in the darkest night
Thunder rolling, spirits taking flight
My feet at the ground and my hands held high
Run to a haven past that stormy sky
Crowd behind me all dressed in white
Shining eyes up to a light so bright
Come on now, clap your hands
Step right through those gates
Found my peace, found in my place
Can't hold back our kingdom battle Hearts are jumping, voices ring
In this love I'm free to sing
Every valley laid low as I walk on through Old worries gone, world made new
A smile breaks white in the warm embrace No more tears left on my face
It's the end of the road, but the start of a life
Just a child come home, yes, I'm feeling alive
But some still wander on the lonesome street
Lost in the shadows, running from heat
Waiting on the change, barely hanging on
They'll get their turn, even if it takes long
Seeds are planted, but it's a patient game
Someday they'll come and call the name
Jump and shout, reach for that crown
In his arms, I'm safe in town
Lights go up and get loud
Can't hold back, I'm kingdom bound
